correctness.rationale: Exact t-coin offset intervals imply precisely three possible isolated-gap positions; the first is present in the sharp t range, and the other two are governed by mutually exclusive equations 4t=a+2 and 4t=a+5. value.rationale: Complete exact isolated-gap classification for all parameters of a natural minimal 3-generator family whose fixed-coin offsets have a persistent isolated hole. The count grows linearly in a, and residue classes 2,3 mod4 have a sharp additional boundary gap; provides explicit perfect-closure obstruction data and natural structural contrast with arithmetic-progressions. Not a finite-only or arbitrary parameter slice.
